fields.why: The text reports vaccination (>=1 dose) percentages for children aged 3, 4 and 5 years (18%, 17%, 26%), an outcome measured in 3 age groups.
Age is the only SPD with per-group values across 3+ levels; race and SVI enter only as model covariates and Table 1 has no tests.
The age percentages are only set side by side; the CI-overlap assertion concerns time since dose 2 (non-SPD), so the mechanical flag is a false alarm.
